title: Bear cub reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bear cub body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#C47A3A'/>
  <!-- bear belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#E8B06B'/>
  <!-- bear head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='22' fill='#C47A3A'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='26' r='9' fill='#C47A3A'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='26' r='5' fill='#E8B06B'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='26' r='9' fill='#C47A3A'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='26' r='5' fill='#E8B06B'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#E8B06B'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#6B3A1F'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='38' r='3' fill='#3A2010'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='38' r='3' fill='#3A2010'/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='1' fill='#FFF5D6'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='37' r='1' fill='#FFF5D6'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 52 Q50 56 55 52' stroke='#6B3A1F' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='68' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#C47A3A' transform='rotate(-20 28 68)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='68' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#C47A3A' transform='rotate(20 72 68)'/>
  <!-- book left page -->
  <path d='M28 62 L48 58 L48 78 L28 82 Z' fill='#F5F0E0'/>
  <!-- book right page -->
  <path d='M52 58 L72 62 L72 82 L52 78 Z' fill='#FFFDF5'/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#D45A3A' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- book cover edges -->
  <path d='M28 62 L28 82' stroke='#D45A3A' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <path d='M72 62 L72 82' stroke='#D45A3A' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <path d='M28 62 L48 58' stroke='#D45A3A' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M52 58 L72 62' stroke='#D45A3A' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- book lines (text) -->
  <line x1='32' y1='66' x2='44' y2='64' stroke='#B8A88A' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='70' x2='44' y2='68' stroke='#B8A88A' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='74' x2='44' y2='72' stroke='#B8A88A' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='64' x2='68' y2='66' stroke='#B8A88A' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='68' x2='68' y2='70' stroke='#B8A88A' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='72' x2='68' y2='74' stroke='#B8A88A' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='90' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#A8642A'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='90' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#A8642A'/>
</svg>
